title: An admission retry replaced by a bind or abort retry for the same prompt loses its first-held time and attempt index
outcome: An admission retry replaced by a bind or abort retry for the same prompt loses its first-held time and attempt index
acceptance: When a bind retry or an abort retry replaces an admission retry for the same prompt, the new record keeps the admission retry's held_since, and a test shows the delegation hold's heldSince does not move backwards across the handoff.
